summary: A 3-day Seoul journey combining K-pop culture, trendy neighborhoods, vegetarian-friendly dining, shopping, and local street experiences across Hongdae, Itaewon, and Yongsan.

days.theme: Hongdae K-pop culture and youthful street food

pois.name: Hongdae Walking Street (홍대 걷고싶은거리)
pois.notes: Explore Seoul's vibrant youth district with street performances, K-pop dance covers, fashion stores, and entertainment venues.

pois.name: KT&G Sangsangmadang Hongdae (KT&G 상상마당 홍대)
pois.notes: Visit a creative cultural complex featuring exhibitions, design shops, and indie Korean culture.

pois.name: Plant Cafe Hongdae (플랜트 카페 홍대점)
pois.notes: Enjoy vegan and vegetarian-friendly dishes including burgers, salads, and desserts popular among international visitors.

pois.name: Myeongdong Kyoja Hongdae Branch (명동교자 홍대점)
pois.notes: Try Korean-style noodles and dumplings with vegetarian options available upon request.

pois.name: AK Plaza Hongdae K-pop Store Area (AK플라자 홍대 K-pop 매장)
pois.notes: Browse K-pop albums, merchandise, photo cards, and character goods near Hongik University Station.

days.theme: Itaewon international cuisine and K-pop lifestyle

pois.name: Itaewon Antique Furniture Street (이태원 앤틱가구거리)
pois.notes: Walk through a unique street filled with vintage furniture, art objects, and multicultural shops.

pois.name: Plant Cafe Itaewon (플랜트 카페 이태원점)
pois.notes: A famous vegan cafe offering plant-based Korean and Western dishes, cakes, and coffee.

pois.name: Itaewon Main Street (이태원 거리)
pois.notes: Discover international food culture, unique fashion boutiques, and Seoul's diverse neighborhood atmosphere.

pois.name: Hybe Insight Area (하이브 인사이트 주변)
pois.notes: Visit the area around HYBE's headquarters, a popular photo spot for fans of BTS and other HYBE artists.

days.theme: Yongsan modern culture and Korean entertainment

pois.name: HYBE Headquarters (하이브 사옥)
pois.notes: Take photos outside the headquarters of one of Korea's biggest entertainment companies and a famous destination for K-pop fans.

pois.name: National Museum of Korea (국립중앙박물관)
pois.notes: Explore Korean history, traditional art, and cultural treasures in one of Asia's largest museums.

pois.name: Vegenarang (베지나랑)
pois.notes: Taste vegetarian Korean cuisine with meat-free versions of traditional dishes.

pois.name: Yongsan Electronics Market (용산전자상가)
pois.notes: Explore Korea's famous electronics district featuring gaming stores, gadgets, and technology shops.

pois.name: Yongsan Family Park (용산가족공원)
pois.notes: Relax in a peaceful green space with walking paths and scenic views before ending the trip.
